prespecification_scope: Seven new focal-stimulus contexts selected from source-paper coverage and explicit repository input rules. Four endpoint contexts have outcomes observed before focal-context selection and are marked accordingly. No new target orbit, support pass, pin search, or phenotype readout was run for selection.
semantics: Fixed external Boolean assignments, synchronous update, full target verified after discovery, permanent target-valued pins, all compatible initial states. No healthy/disease label is inferred from input fractions.

contexts.description: APC input with the MHC-II coordinate enabled; every other external input0.
contexts.source_anchor: Results: In silico modeling of a CD4+ T-cell; Figure2A (APC stimulation of MAPK); Methods: Model validation.
contexts.rationale: The focal input is taken from the APC validation panel. MHC_II=1 is an explicit cofactor condition because the released CD4 rule requires it. CD28 is activated through the released APC term; B7 is left0. This is not an assertion that this full binary environment was used in the source experiment.

contexts.rationale: Choose the extracellular-matrix focal input directly represented in two validation panels. No receptor coordinate is added because the released integrin rule has an ECM term.

contexts.description: Extracellular IL2 with CGC and IL2RB coordinates enabled; every other external input0.
contexts.source_anchor: Results: In silico modeling of a CD4+ T-cell; Figure2E (IL2 stimulation of MAPK); Table1 lists IL2, CGC and IL2RB among environmental variables.
contexts.rationale: The IL2 validation panel motivates the focal ligand. CGC and IL2RB are explicitly fixed1 because both released IL2 receptor rules gate the ligand through these coordinates. IL2RA remains a dynamic internal coordinate. Enabling IL2RB is not assumed to be dynamically neutral: the released SHP2 rule also contains IL2RB directly.

contexts.description: Aggregate Bacteria input on a fixed External_Activator=1 background; every other external input0.
contexts.source_anchor: Background: pathogen sensing through TLRs; Methods, Figure3 integrated macrophage pathway diagram.
contexts.rationale: Bacteria is the repository’s aggregate pathogen coordinate. It activates several distinct PAMP coordinates, so this condition is deliberately not labelled pure LPS stimulation. Virus and all named cytokine ligand inputs remain0.

contexts.description: IFNG input on a fixed External_Activator=1 background; every other external input0.
contexts.source_anchor: Methods: Collection of Molecular Interaction Data and Biological Representation of Pathways, Figure1; Results and Discussion, Figure6A; Methods: Network Analysis of the Transcriptional Response ... to Interferon-gamma Treatment.
contexts.rationale: IFNG is the directly traced input in Figures1 and6A and the stimulus in the paper’s expression experiment. External_Activator=1 is a declared condition of the repository Boolean encoding needed for receptor and signalling-component rows; it is not a named biological ligand or a dose copied from the experiment.
contexts.biological_interpretation: Prespecified Boolean coordinate condition; not an experimentally established full phenotype or reproduction of a published stochastic input environment.

contexts.description: FASLG input on a fixed External_Activator=1 background; every other external input0.
contexts.source_anchor: Results and Discussion, Figure6B (logical follow-through from the FASLG input).
contexts.rationale: FASLG is the second explicitly traced input in Figure6. Preserve the same declared availability background as the IFNG condition. Direct caspase, mitochondrial and transcription-factor activator inputs remain0; any resulting model response must arise through the retained logical rules. No apoptotic phenotype is assumed in advance.

figure_selection_note: The figure contexts were selected before their computations and retained with their observed status regardless of outcome.
target_discovery_note: Target discovery, computational budgets and unresolved-case handling were specified before the focal-context computations. The protocol records inputs and procedures, not outcome-based selections.
classification_note: focal_stimulus is used instead of balanced because no balance of on/off inputs or physiological equilibrium is asserted.
restrictions: Do not identify these complete binary conditions with the source paper’s stochastic ranges or healthy/disease environments.
Do not describe External_Activator as a specific receptor or biological molecule.
Do not interpret the Bacteria coordinate as pure LPS.
Do not call all eligible model coordinates genes; retain the preregistered intervention eligibility definition.
Do not drop contexts that cycle, exceed budgets, or produce inconvenient control costs.
target_selection: For each complete fixed-input assignment, iterate synchronously from regulated coordinates all zero for at most2000 updates. Accept only a complete verified fixed point. A cycle or budget hit is retained as target_not_found, not evidence that no fixed point exists.
selection_status: Four endpoints retained after earlier feasibility outcomes; seven focal contexts and two figure-context identities frozen before their new outcomes.
